evidence.title: Semi-synthetic kratom products linked to four deaths in Utah, state officials say

occurrences.checkable_against: Food and Drug Administration approval records
occurrences.quote_span: Neither are approved by the Food and Drug Administration.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials

occurrences.checkable_against: Utah officials’ warning and product labels
occurrences.quote_span: The labels, officials said, often claim the product is “legal and free of kratom, yet warn it is for ‘adults only/21+’ or produces strong psychoactive effects.”
occurrences.speaker: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials
occurrences.subject: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials

occurrences.checkable_against: Utah Poison Control Center case records and medical examiner records
occurrences.quote_span: Dr. Michael Moss, the medical director of the Utah Poison Control Center, said one of the four deaths was linked to a Buzzers product.
occurrences.speaker: Michael Moss
occurrences.subject: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials

occurrences.checkable_against: Utah controlled-substances law and state public health warning
occurrences.quote_span: The kratom-derived compounds, mitragynine pseudoindoxyl (MGPI) and dihydro-7-hydroxymitragynine (MGM-15), are illegal in the state
occurrences.speaker: Utah state officials
occurrences.subject: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials

occurrences.checkable_against: NBC News request-for-comment records and Exo Club communications
occurrences.quote_span: Exo Club, which makes Buzzers, did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials

occurrences.checkable_against: Utah Poison Control Center call logs
occurrences.quote_span: In recent months, Utah has noticed calls to poison control about cat’s claw products
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials

occurrences.checkable_against: Utah officials’ product-testing warning
occurrences.quote_span: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials warned that the compounds were found in certain herbal supplements, including kratom products, as well as products labeled “cat’s claw.”
occurrences.speaker: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials
occurrences.subject: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials

occurrences.checkable_against: Food and Drug Administration guidance on kratom
occurrences.quote_span: The agency says kratom is not appropriate for use as a dietary supplement.
occurrences.speaker: Food and Drug Administration
occurrences.subject: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials

occurrences.checkable_against: State statutes and regulations governing kratom
occurrences.quote_span: Kratom is banned in at least 10 states, and many others regulate it or have bans on specific kratom-related compounds.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials

occurrences.checkable_against: Utah officials’ laboratory testing records and statement
occurrences.quote_span: Cat’s claw is not a harmful supplement, but testing in these cases revealed it contained MPGI and MGM-15, the statement said.
occurrences.speaker: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials
occurrences.subject: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials

occurrences.checkable_against: Exo Club website product description
occurrences.quote_span: “We extract an indole alkaloid from the Cat’s Claw plant to mirror the effects of popular kratom products,” the website reads.
occurrences.speaker: Exo Club
occurrences.subject: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials

occurrences.checkable_against: Exo Club website product description
occurrences.quote_span: On its website, it says the product does not contain kratom.
occurrences.speaker: Exo Club
occurrences.subject: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials

occurrences.checkable_against: Utah Poison Control Center call records and Michael Moss’s prior NBC News interview
occurrences.quote_span: People were instead reporting symptoms that resemble an opioid overdose, Moss previously told NBC News.
occurrences.speaker: Michael Moss
occurrences.subject: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials

occurrences.checkable_against: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials’ public warning and Utah death records
occurrences.quote_span: Four deaths in Utah have been linked to potent semi-synthetic kratom compounds, state officials said Monday.
occurrences.speaker: Utah state officials
occurrences.subject: Utah health, poison center and agriculture officials
